'''February 2000 Pittsburgh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Starbase One, Pittsburgh, PA on 6 February 2000. It is known from Eric Steinhauser's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d226">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-06-pittsburgh-pa-2-6-2000d226/ pittsburgh-pa-2-6-2000], DeckTech (Eric "Brutus_9" Steinhauser, 6 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-06-pittsburgh-pa-2-6-2000d226/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Starbase One, Pittsburgh, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
